import sys,json,hashlib,base64,time,datetime
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.home()/'.local/share/biome-activation-field'
side=Path.home()/'.local/share/biome-context-reconstruction'
version=json.loads((side/'source-version.json').read_text())
assert version['git_revision']=='c37b8e27dba66206ad2ecc28820c4ee64a161a70',version
sys.path.insert(0,version['source'])
from activation_field.checkpoint import Vault,canonical
from activation_field.provider import gateway
from activation_field.context_reconstruction.transport import read_transfer
g=gateway()
resource='model.context-reconstruction.mac.a0e62492364bd9ddd423'
cases=[
('single','786aa2c3908b466ca2af50dfc6d9b397','6f61a04a22e0f037a045d22983a52530fd351da323d5521a7abf3befeac2c71c',[82082]),
('sequence','08ef25b0bcb04f118ab25d4b5a57cf8f','3fe124b649231fba9a518d03cbf6eac8566f165056ad34d313ac7b26e1c38e18',[82082,72730]),
('zero','2b76ceeaeaec4e0ab8c004594ac927dc','94b89aa274e0024bcf4f86639802455624bf7f7db6d1c4051d0e3c72ac917498',[])]
e=dict(status='running',installed=version,checks={},cases={})
out=root/'context-export-requalification.json'
def save():
 e['observed_at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 tmp=out.with_suffix('.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(e,indent=2));tmp.replace(out)
def check(name,value):
 e['checks'][name]=bool(value);save()
 assert value,name
def cap(action,args,label):
 op='afctx-c37-verified-'+label+'-'+action
 g.invoke('cap.submit',dict(contract='model.context_reconstruction.'+action+':1',resource=resource,operation=op,inputs={'arguments':args}),rid=op,realm='site')
 while True:
  r=g.invoke('cap.submission',dict(operation=op),realm='site')
  if r['state'] in ('succeeded','failed','cancelled','rejected'):break
  time.sleep(2)
 assert r['state']=='succeeded',r
 value=r['result']['result'];assert value['ok'],value
 if action=='export':
  check(label+'_lossless_transport','result_artifact' in value)
  value=json.loads(read_transfer(value['result_artifact'],lambda sha:base64.b64decode(g.invoke('artifact.get',dict(sha256=sha),realm='site')['data'])))
 return value
save()
try:
 for label,job,sha,expected in cases:
  state=cap('status',dict(run_id=job),label)
  check(label+'_job_succeeded',state['status']=='succeeded')
  report=cap('export',dict(run_id=job,expected_version=state['version'],allow_plaintext=True),label)['artifact']
  data=dict(report);integrity=data.pop('integrity')
  check(label+'_integrity',integrity['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(canonical(data)).hexdigest())
  check(label+'_source_unchanged',sha==hashlib.sha256(canonical(Vault(root/'state').manifest('afctx-qualification-'+label))).hexdigest())
  check(label+'_no_history_used',all(report[k] is False for k in ('uses_source_transcript','uses_source_native_caches','uses_source_logits')))
  e['cases'][label]=dict(run_id=job,expected=expected,report=report,exact=report['estimated_token_ids']==expected)
  if label=='zero':check('zero_no_invented_tokens',report['status']=='insufficient_signal' and not report['estimated_token_ids'])
  else:check(label+'_full_model_replay',all(c['scored_projections']==248 and c['scored_layers']==32 for c in report['candidates']))
  if label=='single':check('single_exact',e['cases'][label]['exact'] and report['best_relative_squared_error']==0)
 state=cap('status',dict(run_id='653ec2b449444954b0f1f934da5d5a2d'),'cancelled')
 check('cancelled_terminal',state['status']=='cancelled')
 e['cancelled']=state;e['status']='passed';save()
except BaseException as exc:
 e.update(status='failed',error=repr(exc));save();raise
print(json.dumps(dict(status=e['status'],checks=e['checks'],observed_at=e['observed_at'],path=str(out),cases={k:dict(estimated=v['report']['estimated_token_ids'],exact=v['exact'],residual=v['report'].get('best_relative_squared_error')) for k,v in e['cases'].items()})))
